description: This file implements a sample AWS IoT Jobs client that connects via MQTT, subscribes to job notifications, and processes job updates, including executing jobs and tracking statistics.

classes.name: JobsMessageProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of AWS IoT Jobs messages, manages subscriptions, executes jobs, and maintains statistics.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JobsMessageProcessor with the client and token, sets up callbacks.

methods.name: _setupCallbacks
methods.description: Sets up MQTT subscriptions for various job-related topics.

methods.name: startNextJobSuccessfullyInProgress
methods.description: Callback for successful job start; executes the job and updates status.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Performs the job execution logic, printing job details.

methods.name: newJobReceived
methods.description: Callback for receiving a new job notification.

methods.name: processJobs
methods.description: Starts processing jobs by resetting state and attempting to start the next job.

methods.name: _attemptStartNextJob
methods.description: Attempts to start the next job by sending a request.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if job processing is complete.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Returns current statistics of jobs processed.
